sources.title: Gemini (language model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Gemini is a family of multimodal large language models (LLMs) developed by Google DeepMind, and the successor to LaMDA and PaLM 2. Comprising Gemini Pro, Gemini Deep Think, Gemini Flash, and Gemini Flash Lite, [1] it was announced on December 6, 2023. It powers the Gemini chatbot, and was named after the Gemini zodiac sign.
